name: circled
title: Circled
description: A hand loop around a word or phrase: a circle that overshoots where it started, a box, or a pair of square brackets. It can be written on as it scrolls into view.

a11y: The words are ordinary text; the loop is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none, so it never blocks a click on a link or button inside.
If the circle carries meaning (the correct answer, the item to check) say so in text as well; a drawing alone is not announced.
Until the drawing exists a thin outline shows; in Windows high contrast a real outline is shown instead of the drawing.
